sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive recent form. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five games (four wins and a draw) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 matches. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who are second-bottom with just 4 points and have lost their last four games, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their title advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match that could have title-race implications if Sandbach slip up. Wolverhampton Casuals, who sit fourth with 19 points, host Wednesfield Community at home, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth face a tricky away trip to Eccleshall (sixth, 18 points) in a potential top-six clash. Bilston Town (fifth) entertain Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. At the bottom end, Widnes Town's winless run continues as they visit Brereton Social, Telford Town travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads in a battle between two of the division's weakest performers, and Crewe host Allscott Heath. Market Drayton Town, struggling in mid-table, face New Mills, while Shawbury United (tenth) take on Barnton in a fixture between sides seeking consistency.
